title: Lời chưa nói
about: Round 26, ke-chuyen ("làm luôn 7 bài cho đủ album"): F-sharp minor at 58 bpm, the most held back of the set. Its motif hesitates: one note, a beat's silence, then a few notes rising, as someone starts to speak and stops; the sentences end on the dominant, never quite home. The arc stays low: the piano alone; the violas only at the sentences' ends; the middle in A major with the cellos' slow second line and the violas' thin line, reaching F#6 once and falling back, no strings' climax; the piano alone again, ending on C#7sus4; the motif's last rise stops on G# over F#m(add9), the word unsaid. An original tune.
